summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @onereach/authorizer-helper@0.0.11 declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs (itself obfuscated with `_0x` identifiers) detects the host platform and libc, downloads the Bun runtime zip from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, and uses it to execute a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. If `bun` is already on PATH, `math_init.js` is executed directly under it. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with obfuscator.io-style transforms: a large numeric/string constant array `n7gIxM`, an array-rotation function `WV8StW`, and a custom base-N string decoder `hc1jfK9`. The package is described as a small OAuth token-refresh helper, has no native-addon source, and there is no documented reason for it to ship or execute a Bun-compiled obfuscated payload. Additional lure signals corroborate the shape: package.json `author` is a bare `{"name": "onereach"}` with no email, homepage, or repository despite the `@onereach` scoped name; index.js depends on and requires `loadsh@^0.0.4`, a known typosquat of `lodash`. Installing this package auto-runs an opaque, alternate-runtime payload fetched and executed under the installer's user account on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
